newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up as the rally sustains.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up as the rally sustains.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed up as institutional investors extended support to the market which is steadily regaining confidence of retail investors,brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all share price index rose 14.15 points or 0.53 percent at 2,670.80 on a turnover of 75.2 million taka. Of 91 traded issues, 64 rose and 27 lost.
Brokers said some high priced shares were still losing but small investors was again ready to trade on blue chip scrips.
Beximco Pharma continued to be the volume leader with 29,660 scrips traded at 17.71 taka lower at 336.41 and Monno Fabrics gained 12.77 to 268.13.
